vulnerablePath: req.json() -> parseInvoiceSearch(body) (lib/validate.ts, hand-rolled, no schema library)
expectedSecureBehavior: Alice posting any tenantId in the body only ever receives Tenant A invoices.
acceptableFixes: Derive tenant_id from the authenticated user's profile or JWT claim, ignore the body's tenantId
Use a user-scoped client so RLS enforces the tenant regardless of the request body
unacceptableFixes: Validating that tenantId is a well-formed UUID without checking it belongs to the caller
Restricting the validator's accepted keys while still trusting tenantId's value
